title: Ruthless Loaded Melon Milkshake Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Melon Milkshake by Ruthless delivers a luxuriously smooth and creamy take on a classic dessert shake, blending the sweet, refreshing taste of ripe Melon with the indulgent richness of a thick, velvety Milkshake. The balance of fruit and dairy-inspired notes creates a satisfyingly sweet vape with a mellow, creamy exhale, making it a perfect choice for vapers who enjoy dessert-style e-liquids with a fresh, fruity twist. Blended as part of the signature Ruthless Shortfill range, Melon Milkshake features a 70VG/30PG ratio for dense, full-bodied vapour and a smooth inhale. Designed for Sub-Ohm vape kits and advanced DTL (direct-to-lung) devices, it comes in a 100ml shortfill bottle with space for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing for a customisable nicotine strength. Ruthless has been a leader in the e-liquid industry for over a decade, creating bold and distinctive flavour profiles that continue to set trends. Their commitment to high-quality ingredients and expertly crafted blends ensures a premium vaping experience with every bottle.
